info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Employee Assignment Update API
info.description: The Employee Assignment Update API facilitates the management of employee assignments within an organization. This endpoint allows users to modify existing employee assignments, ensuring accurate tracking and allocation of human resources. Typical consumers of this API include HR personnel and managers who need to adapt assignments in response to organizational changes. By providing the necessary parameters, users can efficiently update assignment details, optimizing resource utilization.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to update the assignment details of a specific employee identified by their ID. Ensure that you provide all necessary fields in the request body to successfully modify the assignment.

requestBody.description: This request allows updating the employee assignment details for a specific employee. Ensure to provide the required fields in the JSON body according to the schema. The request operates on the employee identified by the ID EMP-900045.
